test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Accuracy rates of facial recognition algorithms are ______ low in the case of minorities, women and children, as demonstrated in multiple studies across the world.
solution:
The correct answer is particularly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• “ **Particularly” **is used when the** context is fixed or definite**.
 
• As the context **is fixed here**, “**Particularly”** is the suitable word to fill in the blanks.
 
• The complete sentence, therefore, would be, “**Accuracy rates of facial recognition algorithms are particularly low in the case of minorities, women and children, as demonstrated in multiple studies across the world.”​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **“Carelessly**” means when **something is done without care**.

 
 
• **Example-** *He finished the homework carelessly.*
 
 
 
• **“Smoothly**” means when **something happens** or **is done without any obstacle**.
 
 
• **Example**- *The programme went smoothly*.
 
 
 
• **“Beautifully”** means when **something is done pleasantly or decoratively**.
 
 
• **Example**- *He sings beautifully.*
